context_requirements: DPP4 (CD26) expression on the cell surface
an intact DPP4-dependent peptide/incretin signaling axis
cell lines that are not already saturated for the relevant downstream pathway
falsifiers: reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
a shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in DPP4-negative controls
changes in known DPP4 substrate-responsive genes such as CXCL2, IL1B, or PTGS2
